name: GradientOrbs
description: Glowing radial-gradient orbs float on seeded CSS loops and lean toward the pointer with lerped parallax, where nearer (larger, sharper) orbs move further than distant, softer ones.
a11yNotes: The orb field and vignette are aria-hidden with pointer-events: none, so children stay fully interactive. Floating pauses off-screen or at speed 0; prefers-reduced-motion stops floating and disables pointer parallax. Orb layout uses a seeded random so SSR markup is stable.

propsApi.name: blur
propsApi.description: Base blur radius in px; distant orbs are blurred more.

propsApi.name: followPointer
propsApi.description: Orbs drift toward the pointer with depth-based parallax.

propsApi.name: height
propsApi.description: Height of the background in px.

propsApi.name: children
propsApi.description: Content rendered centered on top; defaults to a heading and subline.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
